The Unreal Conditional: Expressing Causal Connections
You use the Unreal Conditional to express a relationship between a cause and an effect in a hypothetical way.
If it hadn't been for the for people who helped him, he would sitting there in a daze.
You use if it was not for + noun phrase to say that one situation depends on another situation or person to come true. You use If it weren't for … if you want to express yourself more formally.

Example:
If it weren't for overzealous reporters making fun of stories, more people wouldn't be worrying about telling them.
If you want to make a causal connection to a past situation, you can use If it had not / hadn't been for + noun phrase.

Example:
If it hadn't been for the people who helped him, he would sitting there in a daze.
In a formal context you can use Had it not been ... or Were it not for …

Example:
Were it not for us, the authorities would be fielding a lot of calls from citizens.
If it weren't for overzealous reporters making fun of stories, more people wouldn't be worrying about telling them.
Were it not for our organization, sightings would not be organized into a database.
Were it not for us, the authorities would be fielding a lot of calls from citizens.
Had it not been for us, many could end up in hospitals or psychiatric facilities.
Differences Between -ing and To-Infinitive

When you talk about two actions linked together, you normally use two verbs. The first verb follows the rules of conjugation for the sentence, while the second verb can be a verb in the -ing form or to+Infinitive
We advise callers to tell us exactly what happened.
You can use two verbs to talk about two connected actions. The main verb introduces the main action, and the second verb in the -ing form gives more information about that action.

Structure:
Subject + first verb + -ing form of the second verb / to+ Infinitive
Verbs followed by -ing are imagine, enjoy, consider, mind, keep, love/hate.
Verbs followed by to+Infinitive are ask, promise, agree, expect.

Some verbs can be followed by either an -ing verb or to+Infinitive, like like, love, hate, dislike, intend, dread, advise, recommend, regret …
The difference in meaning depends on the preceding verb.
Forget/Remember with to+Infinitive are looking forward into a future situation. With an -ing form they refer to a past action.
Advise/Recommend with to+Infinitive are followed by an object. With an -ing form there is no object.
Regret with to+Infinitive is a polite form of apology. With an -ing form it has the meaning of If only this hadn't happened .

images.text: He remembered to close the door before he went out to look at the bright object that was in the meadow. He does not remember leaving the yard or anything at all until the next day when he woke up five miles from home in a similar pasture. If it hadn't been for the for people who helped him, he would be sitting there in a daze. I work at the UFO Center Hotline. If you have seen an UFO I recommend calling us. We advise callers to tell us exactly what happened. I also recommend everyone to write down everything before they call.  We advise having privacy when you call as well.

We don't forbid you to go to the press. However, we want to say some can't bear to read what's written. If it weren't for overzealous reporters making fun of stories, more people wouldn't be worrying about telling them. Were it not for our organization, sightings would not be organized into a database. Of course, I regret to say that not all sightings are taken seriously. Were it not for us, the authorities would be fielding a lot of calls from citizens. The government has already invested millions of dollars in research on extraterrestrial life. They may regret me telling you this, but it's true.

Let me go on to say that we help many people over the trauma they sometimes feel when they have UFO sightings. People hate feeling distressed. Had it not been for us, many could end up in hospitals or psychiatric facilities. Some dread talking about their experiences. Others can't stop talking about them.  But for us being here, they would still be carrying around their shock and fear. I love my job here at the UFO call center.
